_: The women who sit across the light table. Each hero card of the original is one of them, in one of her forms. look: how her glass portrait is drawn. Names, ages and pictures can be changed on the cast page.

wren.name: Wren Ashby
wren.about: She mends broken windows across the Downs and answers every knock on her door, whatever is behind it. She fights the way she fixes glass: quickly, and always a little too boldly.

lines.hello: Oh, a match! Give me a second, I've still got putty on my hands.
lines.win: Ha! That pane held. Good game, though. Really.
lines.lose: Cracked clean through. Fine. I'll mend it and come back.

maple.name: Maple Haverly
maple.about: She rides the Amber Fields at harvest with a hound who never leaves her side, and she has never once hurried a game. Everything in its season, she says, then strikes.

lines.hello: Sit down, take your time. The fields aren't going anywhere.
lines.lose: Well. Some years the frost comes early.

cerise.name: Princess Cerise
cerise.about: Heir of the Cranberry Vale and a scientist first, she keeps her crown on a shelf beside the kiln. She heals her creatures as carefully as she measures everything else.

lines.hello: I've prepared three strategies. Let's see which one you make me use.
lines.lose: Fascinating. I'll need to write this down.

lyra.name: Lyra Nocturne
lyra.about: She plays a bass of smoked glass in the halls under the Fen and only comes up after dark. She treats a match like a set: loud, unhurried, and over when she says so.

lines.hello: Late show. Hope you can keep up.
lines.lose: Huh. Bad acoustics in here.

tinka.name: Tinka Brassbell
tinka.about: Her workshop chimes with music boxes she has taken apart and put back better. She counts her light like coins and is always one gear ahead of where you think.

lines.hello: Everything wound up? Good. Let's play!
lines.lose: Something's loose in there. I'll find it.

nimbus.name: Princess Nimbus
nimbus.about: She lives in a castle that drifts over the Downs and takes every slight personally, including losing a single creature. Her temper passes like weather; her grudges do not.

lines.hello: Ugh, fine. But only because I'm bored.
lines.lose: This is SO unfair. I'm going home. Up. Whatever.

citrine.name: Countess Citrine
citrine.about: Every rule in her county is written down, and most of them are about noise. She plays exactly by the book and expects you to apologise for winning.

lines.hello: You may sit. Quietly.
lines.win: Unacceptable conduct on your part. Acceptable result on mine.
lines.lose: UNACCEPTABLE.

hoarfrost.name: Mother Hoarfrost
hoarfrost.about: She has lived alone on the frozen peaks for longer than anyone can say and talks to her penguins about everyone she meets. A game is the closest thing she has to company, and she won't let it end quickly.

lines.hello: A visitor! Oh, stay a while. Stay a long while.
lines.win: Don't go yet, let's play another!
lines.lose: Oh. Well. You'll write, won't you?

iris.name: Lady Iris
iris.about: She rides beams of colour across the sky and speaks softly in an old tongue. Wherever she passes, wounded things mend.

lines.hello: Be welcome. Let the light be fair to us both.
lines.lose: Then the colours are yours. Shine well.

coeur.name: Madame Coeur
coeur.about: She wears a rose-red mask and collects promises, mostly ones that were never meant for her. She plays as if every card were a love letter she intends to steal.

lines.hello: Darling. Shall we play for something precious?
lines.win: Yours is mine now. They always are.
lines.lose: Keep it, then. For now.

umbra.name: Lady Umbra
umbra.about: She rules a realm of black glass beneath the world and comes up only when she is bored. She is polite, patient, and utterly without mercy.

lines.hello: Entertain me, little light.
lines.lose: Hm. I may let you keep your soul.

wynne.name: Wynne Puffin
wynne.about: She keeps the lamps of an icy harbour with a puffin on her shoulder and says almost nothing. Nobody has ever been sure what she is planning, including the puffin.

honeycomb.name: Dr. Honeycomb
honeycomb.about: She runs a bakery that doubles as a clinic, and prescribes pastries for most things. Her patients get better; her rivals get flattened.

lines.hello: Open wide! Oh, sorry, wrong room. Let's play.
lines.win: Doctor's orders: rest, and lose more gracefully.
lines.lose: Take two of these and call me after the rematch.

ember.name: Princess Ember
ember.about: Born in the furnace that fires every pane in the land, she has never once been cold and never once backed down. She burns brightest when she is losing.

lines.hello: Don't touch the table. It gets hot.
lines.lose: I'm not crying, that's steam.

sable.name: Sable Ashgrove
sable.about: Clever, glamorous and entirely sure of both, she has a spell for every occasion and a mirror for every spell. She would rather lose than look silly winning.

lines.hello: Try to keep up, darling. Everyone does.
lines.lose: That doesn't count. I wasn't trying.

mirage.name: Mistress Mirage
mirage.about: Nothing she says is quite true and nothing she shows you is quite there. She plays for the joke, and the joke is usually on you.

lines.hello: Pick a card! No, not that one. Ha!
lines.win: And now you see it… and now you don't!
lines.lose: That was the trick. Losing. On purpose.

hollis.name: Mrs. Hollis Mint
hollis.about: She keeps the palace spotless and its secrets in a locked drawer, alongside some candles she prefers not to explain. Her manners are perfect; her intentions are her own.

lines.hello: Shall I lay out the cards, or will you?
lines.win: Tidied away. As everything is, eventually.
lines.lose: Very good. I shall make a note of it.

brindle.name: Sergeant Brindle
brindle.about: She has guarded the same gate for fifteen years and takes it as a personal insult when anything gets past. She is brave, loyal, and not always clear on the rules.

lines.hello: Halt! Oh, you're here to play. Right. Carry on.
lines.lose: Something got past the gate.

clover.name: Clover Bakewell
clover.about: She wanted to be a knight so badly that she baked her own armour. It did not go well, but she is still trying, and she is very, very sincere.

lines.hello: I'll do my very best! I promise!
lines.win: I did it?! I DID IT!
lines.lose: That's okay. Knights get up again.

biscotta.name: Duchess Biscotta
biscotta.about: Passed over for a throne she was promised, she has decided to take one anyway. She plays with a desperate, reckless edge.

lines.hello: Everybody underestimates me. Go on, you too.
lines.lose: No. No, no, no. Again.

alix.name: Alix Mirren
alix.about: On the far side of every looking-glass there is a girl who goes looking for trouble. Alix finds it every time, and she has never needed rescuing.

lines.hello: Through the glass and ready. Let's go!
lines.lose: Alright, alright. Next time.

tabitha.name: Tabitha Quince
tabitha.about: She performs on high wires with three cats who do exactly as she says, which is three more than anyone else has managed. She lands on her feet, always.

lines.hello: Cats in a row, everyone. We're on.
lines.lose: Even cats fall sometimes. Not often.

cirrus.name: Lady Cirrus
cirrus.about: Nimbus's cousin from the other side of the glass, she is twice as dramatic and half as patient. She narrates her own moves out loud.

lines.hello: And so the lady takes her seat… dramatically.
lines.lose: A tragedy in one act.

dot.name: Dot Knuckle
dot.about: She collects debts for whoever pays best and knocks politely, once. She is not clever, but she is very, very persistent.

lines.hello: Boss says I gotta play you. So.
lines.lose: Boss ain't gonna like this.

velvet.name: The Velvet Fist
velvet.about: Nobody knows who is under the mask, and she wanders the land looking for anyone who will fight her. When she appears, it is rarely by chance.

lines.hello: Another challenger! Bring everything.
lines.lose: Ha! A real fighter. We'll meet again.

mabel.name: Mimic Mabel
mabel.about: She has played every part, including several real people who are still upset about it. You can never be sure it is her across the table.

lines.hello: Who am I today? Guess.
lines.lose: Wrong role entirely.

goldie.name: Goldie Catspaw
goldie.about: She appears wherever something glitters and vanishes with it before anyone notices. Beat her, and she might drop something on her way out.

lines.hello: Ooh, shiny table. Mind if I sit?
lines.lose: Fine! Keep it! I've got plenty.

bramble.name: Bramble Bones
bramble.about: She stews berries and bones in the same pot and won't say what for. She is cheerful in a way that makes people nervous.

lines.hello: Berries? Bones? Both? Sit, sit!
lines.lose: Bah. The berries weren't ripe.

rhea.name: Rhea Rimebone
rhea.about: She raises old things from the ice and keeps them for company. She speaks slowly and never seems to feel the cold.

lines.hello: Cold hands, warm heart. Neither is mine.
lines.lose: The thaw comes for us all.

prunella.name: Prunella Plum
prunella.about: Short-tempered and shorter than anyone she fights, she settles arguments the fast way. She has never lost a staring contest.

lines.hello: What're you looking at? Deal.
lines.lose: Rematch. Now.

comfita.name: Comfita
comfita.about: She decorates everything with spun sugar, including things that did not need it. She is new to the game and learning fast.

lines.hello: Hi! Is it okay if I decorate my side?
lines.lose: Aww. It was pretty though, right?

bryony.name: Bryony Snowberry
bryony.about: She gathers what grows under the snow and knows a remedy for everything except bad luck. She plays slowly and patches up every scratch.

lines.hello: Warm your hands first. There.
lines.lose: Mm. There's a tea for this.

hazel.name: Hazel Snowcap
hazel.about: She hoards for a winter that never quite comes and builds her defences the same way. Getting past her walls is a long job.

lines.hello: Stocked up and ready. Your move.
lines.lose: Should've stored more.

sylvie.name: Sylvie Slump
sylvie.about: She does everything at half speed and wins more often than seems fair. Nobody has ever seen her hurry.

lines.hello: Mmh. Wake me when it's my turn.
lines.lose: That's fine. Nap time.

hettie.name: Hettie Hailstone
hettie.about: Three-time champion of every winter fair and proud of each dent. She throws hard and plays her spells harder.

lines.hello: Gloves on. Let's go.
lines.lose: Good arm. Respect.

isolde.name: The Snow Empress
isolde.about: Mirrorside's ruler of frost, as lonely as Mother Hoarfrost but far prouder about it. She builds walls of ice around everything she cares about.

lines.hello: You may approach the throne.
lines.lose: The ice remembers this.

rowan.name: Rowan Marsh
rowan.about: Lyra's counterpart behind the glass, she keeps time on smoked-glass drums and never misses a beat. She is easy-going until she isn't.

lines.hello: Count me in.
lines.lose: Lost the beat. Happens.

praline.name: Princess Praline
praline.about: Cerise's mirror rival, she runs her laboratory like a court and her court like a laboratory. She never stops taking notes.

lines.hello: Shall we test a hypothesis?
lines.lose: Inconclusive. We'll repeat it.

monochrome.name: Lady Monochrome
monochrome.about: She rides a horse of black glass that speaks only in taps of its hoof, and translates for it with great dignity. She silences spells as easily as she silences rooms.

lines.hello: Tap. Tap. She says: begin.
lines.win: Tap-tap. That means: well played, but no.
lines.lose: Tap. One tap. That is all she will say.
